title: Unexpected warning CS8669: The annotation for nullable reference types should only be used in code within a '#nullable' annotations context. Auto-generated code requires an explicit '#nullable' directive in source.
body:
#### Bug description

MessagePack v3 generates a CS8669 warning for the file `MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackResolver.g.cs` if your code contains a class like the one below.

#### Repro steps

Add the following class to your code and build your project, you will see the CS8669 warning:
```cs
[MessagePackObject]
public class SomeClass
{
    [Key(0)]
    public required List<SomeClass?> Values { get; set; }
}
```

#### Expected behavior

No warning.

#### Actual behavior

Warning CS8669: The annotation for nullable reference types should only be used in code within a '#nullable' annotations context. Auto-generated code requires an explicit '#nullable' directive in source.

- Version used: MessagePack 3.1.3
- Runtime: .NET 9

#### Possible solution

The solution might be to include the line `#pragma warning disable CS8669` in the file `MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackResolver.g.cs`. This line is already present in the other generated files.
